title: The Great Duty of Being Kicked
text: “Were you not injured?”
“Not at all. Some strange fellows tangled with us along the way, but Kitamura-dono dealt with them handily. As for the king… he did not seem inclined to listen to what we had to say.”
“…I see.”
“Well, that should pose no particular problem. What concerned me was this—are we truly not sending Iwatani-dono to Siltvelt?”
“Indeed. The Spear Hero standing right there apparently has the power to travel the world instantly, so getting to Siltvelt would be trivial for him, but…”
“I see… and why is that?”
“Partly my own personal reasons, but if Father were to arrive openly in Siltvelt, it would likely spark a war, I say.”
“Hm?”
“It seems Motoyasu-sama has been living through the same span of time repeatedly, and apparently knows the future.”
“It seems that in most other timelines, he and Eclair-sama never even reunite.”
The crocodile men were explaining the various circumstances to Éclair. It seemed they were also explaining how the protection of Big Sister and the others tied into all of this.
“If that king ever learned such a truth, it is entirely possible he would send troops… Do we know the queen’s whereabouts?”
“Depending on the date, we have been told, but as for exactly where she is at this particular moment, that we do not know, I say.”
I suspected she might be somewhere around Faubrey, but that part wasn’t confirmed either.
“Hmm… if possible, I would like to seek an audience with the queen at once and explain how things stand, but I suppose that cannot be helped.”
“In any case, let us simply wait for that arrogant king to receive his comeuppance like something out of a story. It does seem the Heroes have some sort of plan in mind.”
The rabbit man struck a waiting pose as he said this.
“So then, what are Iwatani-dono and the others up to?”
“It seems he was asked by the Spear Hero to help raise a Filolial, and has been busy with that.”
“It is a most crucial period, I say. If anything strange happens, I will not forgive it, no matter what, indeed.”
At times like these, some odd interference tends to spoil everything, so I had to keep a close watch.
“I am keeping the strictest possible eye on Father, so he shouldn’t be doing anything beyond what I’ve asked of him, I say.”
“Even with contact forbidden, I still feel uneasy…”
“Hmm… for Shion to be this concerned is rather amusing, is it not?”
Éclair let out a small chuckle toward the crocodile man. The crocodile man, looking embarrassed, turned his face away.
“We did cause quite a stir along the way… I only hope he hasn’t been tangled up by more strange sorts.”
“Sadeena is with him, after all. I’d like to believe there’s no need to worry.”
“Isn’t that rather the opposite of reassuring? Considering how many people that woman has drunk under the table… who knows what she might get up to, alone with him like that.”
“Ugh… is that truly something dangerous?”
At Éclair’s question, the crocodile man let out a sigh.

“To be honest, it would almost be better if something did happen—that’s how uneventful it’s been. That is the current Shield Hero for you. He’s so lacking in any hint of romance that the Spear Hero keeps telling him to go get some experience already.”
“Hmm… I spoke with him a little myself, and he did seem quite personable. It seems his true character is nothing like the rumors would suggest.”

It was certainly true that I wanted Father to get along with Older Sister and finally graduate from virginity as soon as possible, I say. Otherwise, it was only a matter of time before Rival really did come back.
“In any case, until the queen returns, I intend to remain here guarding the Heroes…”
Éclair glanced my way.
“There’s no need to guard that one. If anything, my job is basically talking him down whenever he goes on some sudden rampage.”
“Indeed, if you’re not careful, he’ll paralyze you or put you to sleep—thoroughly troublesome, that one. Most days he’s just off playing with the Filolials.”
“I-I see…”
“If you have nothing else to do, I’d rather like you to spar with me, but Éclair-sama, please consider your condition and rest.”
“I hardly think this is a time to be resting, given the circumstances…”
“If anything, now is precisely the time you should rest.”
It seemed Éclair was being steered toward taking it easy. Meanwhile, the crocodile man would apparently stay behind to guard her.
“Well then, I’ll borrow the rabbit man, who looks to be free, I say.”
The rabbit man sprang back, trying to put distance between us, but I closed in and caught him anyway.
“W-what are you planning to do!?”
“I’ve decided to give you an important role, so in preparation, I’ll be leveling you up and reinforcing you, I say. Ah, and if you don’t trust me properly, you’ll get seriously hurt, indeed.”
“That’s exactly what I’m asking—what are you planning!”
What was I planning? Obviously. No—I had already decided, I say.

“Isn’t it obvious, indeed? Later, when Father and the others are moving by cart together with Filo-tan, you’re going to burst out laughing at them and get kicked by Filo-tan for it. That’s your great duty, I say.”
“What is that supposed to mean!? What possible point is there in doing something like that!”
“It’s all a crucial reenactment for the sake of meeting Filo-tan, I say. Since it’s apparently best if I avoid playing the laughing role myself, someone has to do the laughing, indeed.”
“Even so, why does it have to be me!?”
“Because you seem well suited for it, I say. That said, I have no idea if being kicked by Filo-tan would leave you merely ‘hurting,’ so I thought it best to train you up a little first, indeed.”
“Somebody help me! I’m being handed a completely unreasonable role and about to be turned into some mysterious villain!”

The rabbit man called out for help toward the monster merchant’s subordinates inside the tent. They swiftly looked away. Next, the rabbit man turned to the crocodile man. What was this now? Was he planning to get in the way?
“Ahh… is there truly no one else suited for this?”
“I thought Lazy Pig might do, but she’d probably just run off, indeed.”
Lazy Pig, who I’d thought had just returned in a hurry, was already fast asleep in the hammock rigged up to support the trapeze. Was that spot her designated post now, I wondered?
“Even I would run away!! Elena-san! I’m handing this role over to you!”
“Oink… oink.”
Lazy Pig was deep in slumber, showing no sign whatsoever of waking. What exactly had she been doing with Itsuki earlier? I’d have to interrogate her about that later, indeed.
“Well… Theodore, weren’t you praised for being good at acting? Why not just perform exactly the way the Spear Hero wants?”
“Even so, getting kicked by a Filolial is no laughing matter!”
“It’s true that if it lands wrong, it could go well beyond a simple injury…”
The crocodile man and Éclair both wore troubled expressions as they faced the rabbit man.

“The Heroes’ own unique reinforcement hasn’t been applied to that Filo of yours yet, has it? Then it would be wise to strengthen yourself now, while you can. If the Spear Hero is willing to reinforce you thoroughly, accepting isn’t such a bad deal.”
Give it up, the crocodile man sighed.
“Can’t Shion do it instead!?”
“If anything, you, rabbit man, are the better fit, I say.”

Once cleaned up a bit, the rabbit man had a fairly decent face, making him the perfect stand-in for me, indeed. It really came down to a choice between resembling me or resembling the Crimson Swine. Even if the crocodile man burst out laughing here, whether it would actually turn into Filo-tan remained an unknown, I say.
“Enough dragging your feet with excuses—let’s go, I say.”
“Gyaaaaaah!”
“Ahh, here it comes, what’re we doing?”
“Count me in!”
“Let’s all play together!”
“Off we go to play, I say.”
“““Yaaay!”””
“Éclair, will you come along too, indeed? I could level you up while I’m at it, I say.”
“N-no… I’ll pass, thank you.”
For some reason, Éclair declined.
“Better that way. Ah, there’s a highly skilled instructor here—I’ll introduce you later. You should have them teach you.”

The crocodile man said this to Éclair, apparently intending to introduce her to the old woman and the panda’s grandfather. And so, together with Filolial-sama, I set off on a hunt, dragging the rabbit man along with us, I say.
